comments.body:
Merged main into this branch. Main's rewrite of `delete_feature_set` already deletes vectors before rows, so I took that version. `delete_features` (by IDs) still deleted rows first, so this branch now applies the same order there: read the vector uuids, delete the vectors, then delete the rows. A new test fails on main and passes here: a failed vector delete leaves the feature rows in place, and a retry succeeds.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
